class.name: Walker
class.brief_description: A walker's tuning, shown in the inspector.

method.name: walk
method.description: Moves the walker along [code]direction[/code] (normalised by the caller) for [code]time[/code] seconds at its speed, counts one step, and emits [code]arrived[/code] with the step count. Answers the distance moved (m).

class.name: Ticker
class.brief_description: A node that counts the engine's calls into its virtual overrides.

members.member: The keycode of the last key event [code]_input[/code] received; 0 before one.

method.name: is_walker
method.description: Whether [code]obj[/code] is a Walker, or a script that extends one.

method.name: scratch
method.description: Takes [code]bytes[/code] of temp memory and touches it; the call gives it back when it returns.

method.name: temp_in_use
method.description: Bytes of temp memory held now, between calls.

class.name: ExamplePlugin
class.brief_description: The editor plugin the extension adds to the editor.

class.name: Bag
class.brief_description: A bag of four numbered slots, read and written as the properties [code]slot_0[/code] to [code]slot_3[/code].

method.name: score
method.description: The script's [code]_score(x)[/code], or -1 when the script has none.

method.name: has_marks
method.description: Whether the bag carries every flag in [code]marks[/code].

method.name: total
method.description: The sum of [code]xs[/code]. An untyped call may pass an Array, which arrives converted.

method.name: doubled
method.description: A copy of [code]xs[/code] with every element doubled. [code]xs[/code] is borrowed, so the copy is written, not [code]xs[/code].

members.member: Flags, a checklist in the inspector.
An unsigned byte, which reads back past 127.
Shown in the inspector only while [code]show_note[/code] is set.
An object of its own, made with the bag and released with it.

class.name: Tally
class.brief_description: An Object the extension makes once and gives the engine as the singleton [code]ExampleTally[/code].

method.name: bump
method.description: Calls so far, counting this one.

class.name: Ghost
class.brief_description: A Node that exists only in a running game: in the editor its instances are placeholders.
